rules.source_quote: 6. Business income. The assessable income from a business, profession or vocation for a year of assessment shall be the profits of the business computed in accordance with this Act and included in calculating assessable income.

11. (1) In calculating a person's income from a business or investment for a year of assessment, expenses to the extent they are incurred during the year by the person and in the production of income from the business or investment, shall be deducted.

16. (1) For the purposes of calculating a person's income from a business for a year of assessment — (a) the Capital allowances referred to in subsection (2) shall be deducted; and (b) the balancing allowances referred to in subsection (4) shall be deducted.
